Normal q/It/eta/uct/Pt/r/rt/Xtest/lm directions use same cached test representatives and quotient derivatives. Absolute and three relative terms with density measure match195/62; Hamiltonian is negative action. Four independent lapse/shift rows remain separate.

Unsigned mode uses abs-word uppers, directed denominator lowers, ordered nonnegative operations and saved intermediate direction envelopes; positive denominator refusal retained. These are uncancelled construction bounds, not a uniform physical/precision certificate.
No EOS/current/normal value, logarithm/sqrt, source action or producer callback runs in the reference. Fraction evaluation is deferred to root numerical execution.
